heading: multiview MB-2 — `storage-crate-stack`: `language-geometry` in the matrix
text: Addition after the coordinator's question whether the engine should refuse or normalise such a label: it refuses now (decision D53). `validateAsset` reports `section-label-language` when the English and German label of a section differ; a cut is named by letters, the caption adds "Section" / "Schnitt" itself. Normalising the layout to the wider label was not chosen, it would keep two letterings of one cut. Test first in `🧪️tests/✂️section-views` (a differing label on `sliding-door` is refused and places the shapes of the English and German side elevation differently; `B-B` is accepted and places them alike; 27 of 28 before the rule, 28 of 28 after) and two patch cases in `🧫️fixtures/✅️asset-validation`. All 62 section labels of the catalog are letters equal in both languages, so no asset gains a finding. Measured here: `🔎️scan.ts` of `storage-crate-stack` clean.

heading: multiview MC — `steel-column` front
text: Addition (coordinator, 2026-11-25: one precise rule for the slender bodies, and it must hold for `glulam-beam` without the sub-print steps). D51 is that rule: the measure is kept, and the bands in which two views cannot differ by it are declared per asset and view with the physical reason. `glulam-beam`: the steps of 0.24 x 0.04 mm on paper are removed through MC's chain (`🧰️matrix/MC/make/glulam-beam.py` rewritten to put the merged bar and its thin-element text back, `write.sh`: 2 ops applied, second run unchanged; the document equals the committed one again); `S/README.md` asks no band to show what it cannot print. Proposed entries in `🧰️matrix/MX/allowlist.json`: `steel-column` front, bands 100, 200, 500; `glulam-beam` plan, band 500 (230 mm between the outlines, half the difference of 620 and 160 mm, against 240 mm asked). Measured with `🧰️matrix/MX/derived-with.ts`: with the fixture as it is `glulam-beam` 1:500 plan 0.02875 and `steel-column` front at 1:100, 1:200, 1:500; with the two entries no finding in any band. Proofs of `glulam-beam` after the removal: `validateAsset` 0 issues; prints at 1:20 to 1:1000 (every key and range end); check CLI `✓`; `🧊️catalog-silhouette` 1 of 1, `🧊️three-views` 2 of 2, `🌡️catalog-physics` 2 of 2, `✅️asset-validation` 10 of 10 (the breathing and power suites name no beam), as in `multiview-MC.md` before; scan 1 hard finding and matrix 245 ok, 7 fail, both only `derived-view-in-band` plan 1:500, which the entry clears once the coordinator merges it. Until the merge the two assets hold 21 and 7 failing cells.
